title: Milton Friedman Speaks: The Economics of Medical Care (B1234) - Full Video
summary: Milton Friedman lectures to physicians on the economics of medical care, arguing that government involvement raises costs and leads toward socialized medicine. He also discusses licensing and protecting patients from quacks.
why: HN commenters recommend it for Friedman's argument that regulation and lobbying produce a less efficient, centrally planned healthcare system.

quote.text: He explains how regulation eventually results in a centrally planned setup that is less efficient than what used to happen.
